content.user_title: Build a Crypto Business Development Agent
content.value_statement: Crypto exchange teams need a consistent way to identify and qualify token listing prospects. This skill structures discovery, scoring, wallet review, and approval-based outreach.
actual_capabilities: Guides multi-source token discovery across market, social, contract safety, and on-chain data.
Defines a 100-point prospect score with weighted criteria and catalyst adjustments.
Structures deployer wallet checks for funding sources, balances, transfers, identity, and risk flags.
Maps prospects through a 10-stage listing pipeline with human approval before outreach.
Explains model routing, source cost tracking, x402 payments, and ERC-8004 agent registration.
Provides qualification thresholds for outreach, monitoring, wallet review, and rejection.
limitations: The skill provides patterns and criteria, not an executable scanner or complete integration.
Data providers, protocol details, prices, and registration claims can change after publication.
Token scores depend on accurate external data and do not guarantee project safety or listing success.
The guidance does not replace legal, compliance, financial, or independent security review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Listing Qualification
use_cases.description: Create repeatable discovery, scoring, verification, and outreach stages for a cryptocurrency exchange.

use_cases.title: Design a Multi-Source Agent
use_cases.description: Plan an agent that combines free and paid intelligence with cost-aware model routing.

use_cases.title: Review Token Risk
use_cases.description: Assess contract signals and deployer wallet history before a listing prospect advances.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Scoring Rubric
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a repeatable qualification model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 100-point token scoring rubric for [exchange type] using liquidity, market cap, volume, social activity, token age, and team transparency. Include score bands and actions.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Token Prospect
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of one token using collected evidence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [token] on [chain] using these inputs: [metrics and sources]. Show the weighted score, catalyst adjustments, missing evidence, wallet checks, and recommended pipeline stage.

prompt_templates.title: Design the Listing Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow design for business development teams.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a 10-stage listing pipeline for [exchange]. Define entry requirements, review owners, human approval gates, monitoring rules, and success metrics for every stage.

prompt_templates.title: Architect the Full Agent
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced system design across intelligence, payments, identity, and model routing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Architect a multi-chain crypto business development agent for [exchange]. Include source selection, scoring, wallet forensics, model routing, x402 controls, ERC-8004 identity, audit logs, and approval boundaries.

output_examples.input: Score a nine-month-old token with strong liquidity, high volume, active social channels, and incomplete team information.
output_examples.output: Prospect score: 78, Qualified. Liquidity and volume are strong, but team transparency is incomplete. Run wallet forensics before drafting outreach.

output_examples.input: Recommend the next pipeline action when contract and pair addresses are verified but only one intelligence source supports the prospect.
output_examples.output: Pipeline stage: Verified. A second independent source is still required. Hold qualification and outreach until cross-reference checks pass.

output_examples.input: Outline a cost-aware intelligence schedule for a small exchange.
output_examples.output: Use free market and safety sources for routine scans. Reserve paid alerts for high-value checks, log every charge, and review source return monthly.

best_practices: Verify contract addresses and require confirmation from at least two independent sources.
Run wallet forensics on qualified prospects and require human approval before outreach or payments.
Test model routing with representative cases and track the return from every paid data source.
anti_patterns: Do not identify tokens by name alone or qualify prospects from a single source.
Do not automate outreach or payments without explicit approval, verified endpoints, and spending controls.
Do not treat token scores as trading advice, guaranteed safety, or a substitute for compliance review.

faq.question: Does this skill execute token scans?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture, scoring, wallet review, and pipeline patterns that require implementation and data integrations.

faq.question: Is this skill designed for trading bots?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on business development and token listing qualification, not trade execution or investment strategy.

faq.question: Which chains can the workflow support?
faq.answer: The patterns are multi-chain, but each deployment needs suitable market, contract, and wallet data providers.

faq.question: Does a high score prove that a token is safe?
faq.answer: No. Scores prioritize review and outreach. Independent contract, wallet, legal, and compliance checks remain necessary.

faq.question: Can outreach run without a person reviewing it?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires human approval before any outreach is sent.

faq.question: Are x402 payments required?
faq.answer: No. Paid sources are optional. Use verified endpoints, separate payment wallets, spending controls, and return tracking when payments are enabled.
